findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

name: article_related
description: Return the semantic relation graph for one article and locale: cornerstone flag, supporting-for, prerequisites, next steps, comparison peers, related articles, product journey, and editorial related. Every value is a canonical path into the same catalog. Read-only and deterministic.

name: article_cluster
description: List the articles in a topic cluster. Called without a cluster, it returns the full sorted list of cluster ids (with an empty member list) so a caller can discover them. Called with a cluster id, it returns that cluster's members (key, locale, canonical path, title). Read-only and deterministic.

name: article_locale

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_verification_debt, search, fetch · Private data: lint_task_spec, get_verification_report_template, search, fetch · Public sink: article_summary · Destructive: get_task_contract_template, get_verification_report_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_verification_debt, search, fetch · Private data: lint_task_spec, get_verification_report_template, search, fetch · Public sink: article_summary · Destructive: get_task_contract_template, get_verification_report_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool removed since last scan
detail: Tool "article_locale" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
